sources.note: Direct HSS2250 label, independent dimensions and perimeter checks.

notes: Complete projected main lecture-room footprint; the room spans physical L1/L2 and is displayed once on L2.

The shared classification boundary with lobby 2255 is the straight line at y=279. The curve below it is a seating-row/step edge, not the room perimeter. The north passage remains open; this polygon does not claim a partition wall.
The center of the south boundary is obscured by blue CAD hatch in the FIS raster. Its small stepped notch is confirmed by the dimensioned 2018 drawing and visible hatch extent.
Traced area 1941.5 ft² versus Facilities 1888 ft²; scale is independently verified by printed dimensions.
FIS source warns that the viewer plan may be inaccurate and a newer downloadable CAD drawing is available.

The auditorium physically occupies L1 and L2, as printed on the first-floor FIS sheet; its complete horizontal projection is shown once on display floor L2. Internal levels, steps, and paths are not modeled.

The older generated LEDDN layout duplicated all HSS office floors because both share Facilities bkey257. This independent layout retains only the directly identified auditorium, lobby and service room; the original input remains intact for audit.
No campus registration or surveyed footprint is claimed. The overall rectangular exterior envelope is approximate; numbered room boundaries come from the actual floor plan.
The seating plan is dated 2018 and FIS plan 2024. Both remain historical sources; the FIS viewer explicitly warns that updated CAD plans may differ.

No room area is used to set scale. The main-room trace differs by less than 4% from the printed 1888ft². The open passage to separately listed lobby2255 is modeled as a room-selection boundary, not an asserted wall.
